name: compact_5kg_100kmh_cruise_175kmh_dive
description: Hypothetical compact high-wing-loading aircraft. User requirements: 5 kg, 0.30 m enclosing radius, 100 km/h cruise and 175 km/h dive. Other values are unmeasured simulation assumptions, including constant thrust and idealized airbrake force. The companion compact_5kg_30deg.sh requests a 30-degree target passage; angle is a mission setting. No calibrated geometry, propulsion, stability, endurance or Gazebo model is supplied. See docs/compact_5kg.md.
